corrections: Implemented error_queue checking in _send_request() for reader error propagation
Implemented _decode_mcp_result() to parse MCP result envelope (content[0].text)
Added strict envelope validation: content must be array with text type
Added response-size enforcement with MAX_RESPONSE_SIZE boundary check
Added process exit detection while request is pending
Added 6 new test categories (error propagation, result decoding, timestamp, size, exit, etc.)

envelope_decoding.protocol: MCP tools/call response wraps tool result as content[0].text JSON
envelope_decoding.validation: Strict schema: result.content[0].type=='text' and valid JSON

error_propagation.mechanism: Reader thread enqueues MCPProtocolError to error_queue

response_size.enforcement: Each stdout line must be <= MAX_RESPONSE_SIZE (1MB)
